mapper.select: SELECT ct.id, ct.content_type, ct.scheduled_publish_time FROM content ct WHERE ct.deleted = 0 AND ct.status = 'DRAFT' AND ct.scheduled_publish_time IS NOT NULL AND ct.scheduled_publish_time <= #{now} ORDER BY ct.scheduled_publish_time ASC, ct.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content ct WHERE ct.deleted = 0 AND ct.status = 'DRAFT' AND ct.scheduled_publish_time IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET status = 'PUBLISHED', publish_time = #{publishTime}, scheduled_publish_time = NULL, updated_at = #{publishTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content SET status = 'PUBLISHED', publish_time = #{publishTime}, scheduled_publish_time = NULL, updated_at = #{publishTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OFFLINE' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ct.status AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM content ct WHERE ct.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ct.status
SELECT ct.content_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM content ct WHERE ct.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ct.content_type

SELECT CASE WHEN cg.parent_id IS NULL OR cg.parent_id = 0 THEN cg.id ELSE cg.parent_id END AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM content ct INNER JOIN category cg ON cg.id = ct.category_id AND cg.deleted = 0 WHERE ct.deleted = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN cg.parent_id IS NULL OR cg.parent_id = 0 THEN cg.id ELSE cg.parent_id END ORDER BY `count` DESC, category_id ASC

SELECT ct.id, ct.title, ct.content_type, cg.name AS category_name, ct.publish_time FROM content ct LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = ct.category_id AND cg.deleted = 0 WHERE ct.deleted = 0 AND ct.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY ct.publish_time DESC, ct.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
